run_greeter_client: run the gRPC helloworld Greeter client to send a SayHello request and print the response
create_insecure_channel: create an insecure gRPC channel to localhost:50051 using grpc.insecure_channel as a context manager
call_sayhello: call the SayHello RPC method on the GreeterStub with a HelloRequest containing a name
build_greeter_stub: build a GreeterStub from a gRPC channel to invoke helloworld service methods
review_run_function: review the run function that connects to a gRPC server and prints the greeting response
